paragraphs: Engineering answers you can cite. Search research papers, standards, source code, and vendor documentation in plain English — with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval and citation-first summaries. Self-hostable, open source, and free to run.
A Vers3Dynamics project, built on the Elasticsearch + Flask search architecture of Anna's Archive; the legacy book and paper search remains available under /legacy.
